reviews.title: Works great on a linear accelerator
reviews.comment: Fan worked awesome, had a fan connected to a video card die so I needed a 4 pin so the machine would know the fan was running and of course cooling. The original was a 70mm so this fan actually fit perfect in the node rack and provided plenty of cooling until a 70mm fan was ordered and replaced.
